newsitem.title: EGYPT: Gunmen kill police guard in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill police guard in southern Egypt.

text.p: Gunmen thought to be Islamist militants shot dead a police guard in southern Egypt on Friday, security sources said.
The gunmen opened fire at Mohyeddin Tolba Omar in the street in the village of Qasr Ghour near the town of Mallawi, killing him instantly. The gunmen escaped.
Mallawi, 260 km (160 miles) south of Cairo, is the centre of activity of the Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), the largest militant organisation fight the Egyptian government.

The group, which wants strict Islamic rule, is fighting a low-level guerrilla war in Egypt's southern provinces. Almost 1,000 people have been killed and hundreds more wounded since it launched its armed campaign in 1992.
